abstract: The U.S. Trade Representative (Trade Representative) is initiating investigations with respect to acts, policies, and practices of the economies listed in Annex A of this notice related to the failure to impose and effectively enforce a prohibition on the importation of goods produced with forced labor. USTR is seeking public comments in connection with these investigations and will hold public hearings.
action: Notice of initiation, request for comments and notice of public hearings.

agencies.name: Trade Representative, Office of United States
agencies.raw_name: OFFICE OF THE UNITED STATES TRADE REPRESENTATIVE

dates: March 12, 2026: The Trade Representative initiated the investigation.
title: Initiation of Section 301 Investigations of Acts, Policies, and Practices of Various Economies Related to the Failure To Impose and Effectively Enforce a Prohibition on the Importation of Goods Produced With Forced Labor
